title: Astral Pool
description: A basin of liquid starlight glimmers in a shallow depression, its surface perfectly still despite the wind. The fluid is neither hot nor cold but radiates a gentle pressure against your skin, as though the light itself has weight. Tiny motes drift upward from the pool like inverted rain, dissolving into the sky above.

choices.label: Drink from the pool
choices.description: The liquid starlight might restore vitality — or it might overwhelm mortal senses.

outcomes.text: The starlight flows down your throat like warm honey. Energy surges through the party, mending wounds and clearing minds.
The liquid is intoxicating — pure cosmic energy distilled into something drinkable. Your party feels reborn.
The starlight is too potent for mortal bodies. It sears through one hero like liquid lightning, leaving them twitching and dazed.

choices.label: Bottle the liquid starlight
choices.description: Carefully decant the luminous fluid into vials for later use or trade.

outcomes.text: You fill several vials with the shimmering liquid. It continues to glow faintly even when stoppered.
As you bottle the starlight, echo essence crystallizes around the rim. You scrape it into a separate vial.
A vial shatters in your hands as the starlight reacts violently. The flash blinds the nearest hero before you can shield your eyes.

choices.label: Leave the pool undisturbed
choices.description: Liquid starlight feels like something that shouldn't be tampered with.

outcomes.text: You watch the motes of light drift upward for a quiet moment, then turn away. Some things are beyond mortal hands.
